Class ConsoleMessages

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.ConsoleMessages
public final class ConsoleMessages extends Object
Consolidates the warnings and errors Maven printed to the console: one entry per distinct message, with how often it appeared and which modules and goals produced it.

A reactor build repeats the same warning once per module — a JVM notice on stderr, a deprecated plugin parameter — and the repetition buries the few warnings that are different. Folding them is the whole point of this collector.

These messages are deliberately not Findings. Findings carry stable keys derived from structured events and are what the ledger gates on; console text is prose that changes with plugin versions, so it is reported and never gated.

    • accept

      public void accept(String line, BuildActivity.Context context, String root)
      Offers one rendered console line; lines that are not warnings or errors are ignored.
      Parameters:
      line - the line as Maven rendered it, level prefix and terminal styling included
      context - what the logging thread was building
      root - the execution root, removed from the message so the same warning reads the same on every machine; empty when unknown
